title: Syntax automaton transition
statement: Define a transition on syntax states for each input bit. From the optional-value component, an unrecorded bit is stored; after a stored false, a false clears the stored value and a true enters state $0$; after a stored true, a true clears it and a false enters state $5$. From one of the six finite states, apply the six-state transition: from state $0$, move to $1$ on $1$ and to $4$ on $0$; from state $1$, move to $2$ on $1$ and to $0$ on $0$; from state $2$, move to $2$ on $1$ and to $3$ on $0$; from state $3$, move to $1$ on either bit; and from states $4$ or $5$, move to state $5$ on either bit.
